articles.title: d-Matrix Adopts NVIDIA NVLink Fusion for Rack-Scale XPU Deployment
articles.body_text: AI inference chipmaker d-Matrix today announced it will use NVIDIA NVLink Fusion to connect its next-generation Raptor XPUs to NVIDIA’s AI infrastructure platform — joining a growing roster of ecosystem partners.
